_about: Step 31 (D-287): the court's segments, square by square. PROVISIONAL: Shaun has not ruled. One table, read by both engines (board.segments, engine.js SEG), so a ruling changes this file only. G the green zone; ML MM MR mid-range left, middle, right; LL LR the long two along each baseline; Ll Lr the long two above each elbow; CL CR the corners; WL WR the wings; T the top. '?' squares count in every segment listed under both. Rows 13 and 14 (deep squares) count with the segment they sit behind (row 12); row 1 with row 2.

names.LL: the long two on the left baseline
names.Ll: the long two above the left elbow
names.Lr: the long two above the right elbow
names.LR: the long two on the right baseline
